title: REQ · characterSchema tests assert real parsing, defaults and rejection
summary: characterSchema tests fail when the schema behavior is missing.
description: Context: game/src/content/schema.ts L47-L60 defines characterInteractionSchema and characterSchema with scale default 1, layer default 'characters', required idle animation and optional interaction. The current tests cover only interaction. Desired behavior: tests also assert defaults, required idle and invalid values. Expected result: removing any of these schema rules fails a test. Why: the schema is the content contract for NPCs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a character without scale and layer, when parsed, then scale equals 1 and layer equals 'characters'
Given a character without animations.idle, when parsed, then parsing throws
Given a character with scale 0 or a negative scale, when parsed, then parsing throws
technical_constraints: Tests run with vitest from game/ using in-memory input only
definition_of_done: Schema behavior covered by tests that depend on the real characterSchema
